rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and technical tooling from her work at Anthropic, Bun, and Vercel—skills that could inform how robotics and hardware systems are documented and made accessible to engineers. Parth's background in mechanical design, controls engineering, and hands-on hardware testing across industrial automation represents a fundamentally different domain, but both work at the intersection of complex systems and making them work reliably at scale.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Parth Behani — Lydia's background in developer experience and tooling strategy at Anthropic and Vercel, combined with Parth's expertise in hardware testing and mechanical systems at Tesla, represent complementary perspectives on how to bridge software and physical engineering challenges.
